statement: Flavio Bolsonaro receives more valid votes than Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in the Brazilian presidential runoff held on 2026-10-25.
resolution: TSE official results for the presidential runoff held on 2026-10-25 show Flavio Bolsonaro with more valid votes than Lula da Silva.
failure_condition: Lula da Silva receives at least as many valid votes as Flavio Bolsonaro, or no presidential runoff is held on 2026-10-25.

statement: The Partido Popular wins more seats in the Congress of Deputies than any other party in the Spanish general election held on 2026-11-29.
resolution: Spanish Interior Ministry official results for the general election held on 2026-11-29 show the Partido Popular with strictly more Congress seats than every other party.
failure_condition: Another party wins at least as many Congress seats as the Partido Popular, or no general election is held on 2026-11-29.

statement: The French National Assembly adopts a motion of censure against the sitting government between 2026-10-12 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: Assemblee nationale official vote records show a motion of censure adopted by the required absolute majority in a vote held between 2026-10-12 and 2026-12-18.
failure_condition: No motion of censure reaches the required absolute majority in any National Assembly vote held between 2026-10-12 and 2026-12-18.

statement: Democratic Party candidates win at least 17 of the 35 US Senate contests of the 2026-11-03 elections, counting any runoff held on or before 2026-12-12.
resolution: AP race calls as of the deadline show Democratic Party candidates winning at least 17 of the 35 Senate contests of the 2026-11-03 elections, counting any runoff held on or before 2026-12-12.
failure_condition: Democratic Party candidates win 16 or fewer of the 35 Senate contests of the 2026-11-03 elections.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at its meeting ending 2026-10-28. Reference: target range 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: FRED series DFEDTARU, the target range upper limit, reads 4.25 or higher for 2026-10-29. Reference: 4.00 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The federal funds target range upper limit is 4.00 percent or lower on 2026-10-29.

statement: Nvidia shares close at or above 248.00 dollars on Nasdaq on at least one trading day between 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 233.95 dollars at the 2026-10-02 close, about 237 intraday on the packet date.
resolution: The Nasdaq official closing price of NVDA is 248.00 dollars or higher on at least one trading day between 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 233.95 dollars at the 2026-10-02 close.
failure_condition: NVDA closes below 248.00 dollars on every Nasdaq trading day between 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-30.

statement: CISA adds at least one further Citrix NetScaler vulnerability, beyond CVE-2026-88779, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-10-06 and 2026-11-06.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog carries at least one Citrix NetScaler entry with a date-added value between 2026-10-06 and 2026-11-06.
failure_condition: No Citrix NetScaler vulnerability has a KEV date-added value between 2026-10-06 and 2026-11-06.

statement: At least one person is arrested on charges tied to the 2026-10-04 block party shooting in Vienna, Dooly County, Georgia, between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-26.
resolution: The Georgia Bureau of Investigation or the Dooly County Sheriff confirms an arrest, made between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-26, on charges tied to the Vienna shooting of 2026-10-04.
failure_condition: No person is arrested on charges tied to the Vienna shooting between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-26.

statement: The United States carries out at least one military strike on a target on Iranian land territory between 2026-10-12 and 2026-12-04.
resolution: The Pentagon, CENTCOM or the White House confirms, or both Reuters and AP report, a US strike on Iranian land territory carried out between 2026-10-12 and 2026-12-04.
failure_condition: No US military strike hits Iranian land territory between 2026-10-12 and 2026-12-04.

statement: At least one commercial vessel is struck or attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.
resolution: UKMTO publishes at least one incident notice of a vessel struck or attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman, with an incident date between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.
failure_condition: No commercial vessel is struck or attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.
